data.hypothesis: Within the existing warp-per-target mapping, explicitly computing reciprocal distance with rsqrtf and forming 1/r^3 by multiplication may reduce the per-interaction cost relative to sqrtf followed by division. The change can alter rounding, so it must pass all correctness checks before being measured.
